shared_elements: low-relief figures with arms extended forward holding objects
handled/stemmed vessel or cup held in hand
figures facing one another across an intervening object
long garment reaching to the ankles
field of figures set within a rectangular/curved framed panel
small inscribed signs in the field
justification: Both surfaces depict profile human figures in low relief presenting or holding vessels toward something between them, a broadly shared offering/presentation scheme with small signs in the field. But A shows several small figures around a heaped offering table under a canopy-like structure with a separate lower register, whereas B shows just two monumental figures filling the whole field, confronted at equal scale with fringed patterned robes and elaborate coiffures, and the drawing conventions (proportion, detail of hair and dress) differ markedly.
